# Shardendu Mishra — Engineering Notes & Technical Blog
> Technical blog featuring deep-dive articles on modern full-stack web development, system architecture, Go backend engineering, reactive Svelte 5 patterns, and database internals.

## Published Articles
- [Comprehensive Guide to Full-Stack Web Development](https://blogs.mishrashardendu22.is-a.dev/read/24) — Complete architecture roadmap from front-end state to back-end services.
- [Demystifying Database Indexing: A Complete Guide](https://blogs.mishrashardendu22.is-a.dev/read/23) — B-trees, hash indices, query optimization, and execution plans.
- [Building Scalable Microservices with Go and Docker](https://blogs.mishrashardendu22.is-a.dev/read/21) — Production containerization, health probes, and Go concurrency patterns.
- [Mastering React Hooks: From Basics to Custom Hooks](https://blogs.mishrashardendu22.is-a.dev/read/18) — Idempotent state management, memory leaks, and reusable custom hooks.
- [CSS Grid vs Flexbox: When to Use Which](https://blogs.mishrashardendu22.is-a.dev/read/17) — Modern layout paradigms, responsive container queries, and subgrid.
